, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the target individual at the outset, stating that James Douglas, 3rd Earl of Angus’s father was “George Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus.” The correct father is William Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus. This factual error (including a non-existent “George Douglas, 2nd Earl of Angus”) misdirected the research toward the wrong person and led to repeated, inconsistent searches, preventing a correct determination of the birthplace.
